name: Orange Juice
steps: Wash and dry the oranges before cutting, even though the peel will not be used.
Halve the oranges across their centres and juice them with a citrus press.
Remove all seeds; strain through a coarse sieve only if you want less pulp.
Stir the collected juice and divide evenly among four glasses. Yield depends on how juicy the fruit is.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate in a clean covered jug and use the same day.
tips: Serve freshly prepared. Adjust sweetness after tasting.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
